done: Landed both committed setup templates (packages/docs-snippets/nativewind/ on NativeWind 4.2.6/Tailwind 3.4.19 with withNativeWind+inlineRem 16 and .dark:root tokens; packages/docs-snippets/uniwind/ on Uniwind 1.11.0/Tailwind 4.3.3 with withUniwindConfig(cssEntryFile,dtsFile) and @theme/@variant, no config file), the two command scripts packages/docs-snippets/commands/{nativewind,uniwind}.sh carrying the literal `npx --yes @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/{engine}/…` recipes, the proof helper tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/quickstart-consumer.ts, and the focused real-process test quickstart-consumer-install.test.ts (5/5): fresh OS-derived Expo 57 consumers outside the monorepo install conversation/message/prompt-input/item/sheet from the live public registry and compile with pinned engines, 8/8 NAV_THEME==CSS token coherence, ordered provider topology with PortalHost last, and fail-closed sensitivity on a removed item module.
deviations: Consumer-side `declare module 'react-native' { interface TextInputProps { placeholderClassName?: string } }` augmentation in packages/docs-snippets/uniwind/lib/theme.ts: RNR's uniwind input.tsx destructures placeholderClassName but no uniwind version (1.6.3–1.12.0) declares it; RNR's installed component source is left byte-unpatched.

uniwind-types.d.ts is a script-form (non-module) file because TS 6 rejects `declare module '*.css'` in modules (TS2882); the canonical `declare module 'uniwind'` augmentation was dropped and _layout.tsx uses NAV_THEME[isDark ? 'dark' : 'light'].

The 5-item install pulls RNR primitives from reactnativereusables.com and our items from the deployed registry's own raw.githubusercontent.com/hackerpug-ai/rnr-ai-elements/v0.2.1 dependency metadata; all top-level recipe URLs point at rnraielements.com.
concerns: The focused test takes ~100s (two real installs + compiles) — downstream consumers of these templates should reuse packages/docs-snippets/commands/*.sh rather than re-deriving install commands.
uniwind template relies on the placeholderClassName augmentation; if RNR upstream renames or uniwind adds the prop natively, the augmentation becomes inert but harmless.

Template package.json deps are intentionally exempted from fallow (packages/docs-snippets/** ignorePatterns from FIX-ORI-RN-001-1); adding more templates under that path silently widens the exemption.
findings: RNR's uniwind input.tsx has a latent upstream bug: it destructures a prop (placeholderClassName) that no uniwind version declares — worth reporting upstream; any consumer compiling RNR uniwind input without an augmentation fails typecheck.

The deployed registry (rnraielements.com) serves dependency metadata pointing at raw.githubusercontent.com/hackerpug-ai/rnr-ai-elements/v0.2.1 for our own items — the canonical-registry hosting story for library items is GitHub raw, not the Worker, until ORI-AST-008-style items are hosted directly.
TS 6.0.3 in consumer workspaces rejects module-form ambient css declarations (TS2882) — template authors must keep .d.ts ambient css imports in script files.
expo-doctor passes with 21/21 checks on both fresh consumers using the committed templates.

scope_impact.found: Both consumer templates are committed at packages/docs-snippets/{nativewind,uniwind}/ with ordered provider topology and NAV_THEME bindings.
scope_impact.change: The seed-data chat screen should be authored as a template overlay/install step on top of these consumers, reusing lib/theme.ts and the provider order verbatim; do not re-derive root wiring.

scope_impact.found: The literal install recipes live in packages/docs-snippets/commands/{nativewind,uniwind}.sh and resolve the RNR CLI to 1.0.0 against the live registry.
scope_impact.change: Execute those exact scripts for the six engine/platform legs; the resolution-manifest.json format (run id, hashes, versions, statuses) is the evidence shape to extend.

scope_impact.found: The nativewind consumer compiles with TS 6.0.3 and nativewind 4.2.6 pinned.
scope_impact.change: The independent NativeWind consumer proof can reuse the nativewind template as its baseline rather than creating a third consumer from scratch.

feedback: The task's write_allowed correctly anticipated the fallow exemption need only implicitly — template-package tasks should pre-declare that their package.json deps are fallow-exempt to avoid the FIX round-trip.
A verify command that fetches the live registry should state the expected byte-hash source (repo-local canonical bytes vs live fetch) — the reviewer had to reconcile the two hash origins.
